title: Le Creuset Cast Iron Skillet No.16 – Orange – Made in France – Small Frying Pan
description:
Authentic Le Creuset cast iron skillet No. 16 in the classic orange color. This compact frying pan is made in France and features the brand’s famous durable enamel coating.
Perfect for small portions, frying eggs, sauces, individual servings, or oven dishes. Its size also makes it ideal for camping, small kitchens, or collectors of Le Creuset cookware.
Details:
• Brand: Le Creuset
• Type: Cast iron skillet / frying pan
• Size: No. 16 (approx. 16 cm / 6.3 in diameter)
• Color: Classic Le Creuset orange with cream interior
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Made in France
Condition:
Good used condition with normal signs of use. The enamel interior is clean and well maintained.
A great piece of iconic French cookware, perfect for everyday use or for Le Creuset collectors.
